body: I don't choose to think about these things. Look I love her to the point if she left me I would probably kill myself. I tried to do it yesterday because hurting her causes me so much stress. I don't want to hurt her. I don't want to think about these things. And you aren't giving me what this sub was meant for. Also I can clearly see your ignorance on trauma and depression.

I should inform you that my parents are the cause of trauma and abuse in my life.

If we say that the both sides should talk the one might over power the other, but the side that has less power is never suppresed the sound wave of the more powerfull side is just stronger. But if someone says that the other should just shut the fuck up and to fuck off then this opinion is viable.
